home_management.title: Home Management Web App
home_management.description: A simple and efficient web application for keeping track of daily home activities, tasks, and household management notes.

features.1: Track and organize daily household activities and chores in an easy-to-use interface.
features.2: Manage family members' tasks and responsibilities with user-friendly assignment features.
features.3: Keep records of important household events, maintenance schedules, and regular activities.
features.4: Create and maintain to-do lists for different areas of home management and daily living.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.sub_title: Turning challenges into milestones, one achievement at a time

appreciation.description:
Dear Truong,

I wanted to take a moment to express my sincere gratitude for your exceptional dedication and effort in developing our home management application. Your attention to detail and commitment to creating a user-friendly interface has truly exceeded our expectations.

What impressed me most was how you took the time to understand our needs and translated them into practical features that make our daily tasks so much easier to manage. The application is not just a tool – it's become an essential part of our household routine.

Your responsiveness to our feedback and the quick implementation of improvements showed your genuine commitment to delivering the best possible solution. It's rare to find someone who takes such pride in their work.

Thank you again for your hard work and professionalism. It has been a pleasure working with you.

certification.description: I was honored to receive a "Certificate of Appreciation" from Bosch for my contributions to the ThermalON project. This project leveraged Micro Frontend technology to enhance scalability and modularity in web applications. Being part of this innovation-driven initiative allowed me to deepen my expertise in modern web architectures while collaborating with a talented team to deliver impactful solutions.

udemy.description: Throughout my self-learning journey and efforts to enhance my professional skills, I have completed various high-quality courses on Udemy and earned certificates in web development, backend programming, and modern technologies such as React, Spring Boot, Docker, and CI/CD. These certificates reflect my continuous learning mindset and commitment to staying up to date with the latest industry practices, enabling me to build effective and optimized software solutions.
